    Profile

    Shayna was born in Envylia as part of a bloodline of prominent martial artists. Thanks to her specialized education and innate talents, her abilities grew into a reckonable force. She's been active integrating beauty and cuteness into her martial arts, and this has turned her into a celebrity in the world of martial arts.

    Origin: Envylia
    Gender: Female
    Height: 164cm
    Weight: 54kg
    Birthday: Sep 17
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Ice Water Wolf
    Likes: Her own ability
    Hobbies: Research into looking pretty from the right angle
    Illust: ―
    CV: 高野麻里佳
